subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active subagent wake provenance be exposed as a public `AgentSession.steer` options API, or kept as an internal queued-wake option while preserving the current public call shape?
rationale: The fix needs per-message provenance, but the PR currently adds a public SDK export and rewrites a public `AgentSession.steer` signature; repository policy treats plugin API surface changes as compatibility-sensitive and this is not a purely mechanical choice.

options.title: Keep provenance internal for this fix
options.body: Rebase the branch so internal active-wake queueing can attach provenance without expanding the public plugin SDK API beyond the existing steer call shape.

options.title: Accept the public steer option
options.body: Explicitly approve `AgentSessionSteerOptions` as a public API addition, then require compatibility tests and docs/release-note context for the new external contract.

options.title: Pause for a broader provenance API
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define a general provenance API that covers active wakes, spawned tasks, and other inter-session paths together.

recommendation.title: Keep provenance internal for this fix
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch so internal active-wake queueing can attach provenance without expanding the public plugin SDK API beyond the existing steer call shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and CODEOWNERS evidence make `steipete` the best available owner for the public API and rebase direction decision.
